name: whooper
title: Whooper
description: Finds the pull requests waiting on your review, reviews each with a coding-agent run, and submits the review you choose as one GitHub review.

prerequisites.purpose: Reads your review requests and pull requests, and submits your reviews, with your GitHub login.
Reads the review asks in your Slack channel.
Reads and writes Whooper's JSON files.
Supplies the Python and packages Whooper's scripts run with.
Runs the jobs the settings give to Claude.
Runs the jobs the settings give to Devin.

actions.name: status
actions.title: Status
actions.description: Prints whether Whooper runs or is paused, the next round, and the last round, as JSON. Reads files only.

actions.name: round
actions.title: Poll now
actions.description: Runs a round now: polls GitHub and Slack and reviews what it finds. Posts nothing.

actions.name: pause
actions.title: Pause
actions.description: Skips the scheduled rounds until you resume.

actions.name: save-settings
actions.title: Save settings
actions.description: Checks settings against the schema and saves them in Whooper's config.

actions.name: draft
actions.title: Change a draft
actions.description: Includes or leaves out a comment, edits its text, or sets the review's event or message, in Whooper's state folder.

actions.name: ask
actions.title: Ask about this
actions.description: Answers a question about a review with a run of the review's agent that reads the review's record and writes nothing else.

actions.name: submit
actions.title: Submit review
actions.description: Posts the chosen comments and the approval or comment to GitHub as one review, with your gh login.
